title: Day 1 Diagnostic — Build your English brain
purpose: Kiểm tra xem kiến thức đã chuyển từ nhận biết sang phản xạ hay chưa. Đây không phải bài thi để lấy điểm đẹp.

questions.prompt: A colleague explains why a deadline moved. Which reaction sounds natural if you understand the reason?
questions.explanation: ‘That makes sense.’ is a high-frequency reaction chunk.

questions.prompt: Someone gives a reasonable explanation, but you do not necessarily agree with everything. Best reaction?
questions.explanation: ‘Fair enough.’ acknowledges that the other person’s reason is reasonable.

questions.prompt: When speaking under pressure, which strategy best helps you avoid freezing?
options: Build a sentence spine first: I need… / I think… / We decided…
Translate the whole Vietnamese sentence first
Search for advanced vocabulary before speaking
Correct every tense before finishing the thought
questions.explanation: A clear subject–verb spine lets you finish the thought, then expand it.

questions.prompt: In natural English, what usually carries the strongest beats?
questions.explanation: English rhythm tends to highlight information-bearing words while many function words weaken.

questions.prompt: Choose the most natural way to soften ‘I’m tired’ in casual conversation.
questions.explanation: ‘kind of’ works as a conversational softener.

questions.prompt: Which learning unit is most valuable for spontaneous speaking?
questions.explanation: Fluency depends heavily on rapid retrieval of familiar patterns tied to communicative intentions.

spokenChallenge.prompt: Speak for 60 seconds about your life lately. Use at least four of today’s chunks.
